output.response: BAF (bunker adjustment factor) covers fuel price changes; LSS (low sulphur surcharge) covers the extra cost of low-sulphur fuel required by emission rules. Both are charged per container on top of the base rate. The customer always sees an all-in price in QuotePort, so the line's surcharges are included in the quoted price. On price lists published all-in, the rates already contain every surcharge and nothing is added on top.

evidence_used: Missing commodity returns no offer
Commodity request process and lead time
Lithium batteries are class 9, HAZ line only
output.response: QuotePort returns no offer because lithium batteries are not in the commodity list. Send the commodity request form to the commodity data team (commodity-data@northwind.example) with the commodity name, the HS code and the IMO class; lead time is two business days. Lithium batteries are IMO class 9 dangerous goods, so once added they can only be quoted on a HAZ line: a HAZ surcharge applies and a dangerous goods declaration is required before booking.

evidence_used: SOC definition and pricing rationale
Typical 150-250 USD gap on Le Havre to Shanghai
output.response: The SOC flag marks a price line for shipper-owned containers: it applies when the customer ships in its own container instead of Northwind equipment (flag added in TideRate 3.2). SOC rates are lower because Northwind does not provide, reposition or maintain the container; on Le Havre to Shanghai the SOC line is usually 150 to 250 USD below the standard 40HC rate. SOC lines only accept general cargo.

evidence_used: Inland tariff table: no INL00 for FRTLS-FRMRS
output.response: The inland pricing team adds missing inland rates. The data confirms there is no INL00 pre-carriage rate for Toulouse (FRTLS) to Marseille (FRMRS). Send the request to inland-pricing@northwind.example with the inland point, gateway port, charge code INL00, equipment sizes, the date from which the rate is needed and the affected quotes or tickets. They load it within two business days; once it is valid in the inland tariff table, QuotePort adds it automatically to new quotes.
